UWSGI_PORT.description: The port the UWSGI server should bind to. If empty, it is read from the bind config file.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the UWSGI configuration file.

UWSGI_INI_APP.description: Path to the specific UWSGI application ini file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the configuration file containing bind settings.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_SECTION.description: Section name in the bind config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_IP_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the bind IP in the config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_PORT_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the bind port in the config file.

UWSGI_BIND_CONFIG_WORKERS_DIRECTIVE.description: Directive name for the number of workers in the config file. If empty, defaults to nproc/2.
